Unmortgaging the utilities seems smarter: $83 each for Electric and Water Works gets me both for ~10x dice rent, roughly $70 per landing, for $166 total, leaving $159 cushion. Since no opponent has a monopoly yet, their max unimproved rent is small, so this feels safe — I'll go ahead and unmortgage Electric Company first.
